headline: Skip Thursday's group run after Wednesday's tempo-labelled effort
summary: Sleep and overnight heart-rate measures improved, but Garmin Training Readiness is 28 (Low), recovery time is 34h 30m, and Wednesday's 8.18 km run added load 173 with aerobic effect 4.2 despite a full-rest prescription. Take full rest from training today.

recovery.label: Sleep
recovery.context: Confirmed Sydney sleep window: approximately 7 October 23:44–8 October 06:38. Garmin recorded 6h 48m of sleep against an estimated need of 8h 30m; duration was rated fair.

recovery.label: Sleeping HR
recovery.context: 4.0 bpm below the prior 7-night valid-sample average of 67.0 and 4.6 bpm below the prior 14-night valid-sample average of 67.6 (13 valid nights).

recovery.label: Resting HR
recovery.context: Matches Garmin's seven-day average of 59 bpm.

recovery.label: HRV
recovery.context: The overnight value is 1 ms below the weekly average, and Garmin classifies HRV as balanced.

recovery.label: Stress
recovery.context: Today's average stress is an incomplete early-morning device measurement; Garmin's average sleep stress was 15.

recovery.label: Body Battery
recovery.context: Garmin recorded 58 points charged overnight and a 59-point sleep impact.

recovery.label: Training Readiness
recovery.context: Garmin reported 34h 30m of recovery time and advises balancing training load.

recovery.label: Recent load
recovery.context: Garmin classifies the workload ratio as high; Wednesday's run added load 173.

yesterday.title: Wednesday run replaced the prescribed rest day
yesterday.summary: Garmin recorded one run: 8.18 km in 45m 47s at 5:36/km, average HR 158, maximum HR 175, load 173, aerobic effect 4.2 and anaerobic effect 0.0. Garmin labelled the training effect TEMPO.
yesterday.prescribed: Full rest from running, cycling and strength work; optional only 20–30 minutes of very easy walking or 10–15 minutes of gentle mobility.
yesterday.completed: Running · 8.18 km · 45m 47s · 5:36/km · average HR 158 · maximum HR 175 · load 173 · aerobic effect 4.2 · anaerobic effect 0.0 · elevation gain 84 m.
yesterday.adherence_assessment: Did not follow. A tempo-labelled 8.18 km run was not the prescribed rest or approved lower-load alternative.
adherence_evidence: The 7 October report prescribed full rest from running, cycling and strength work.
Garmin recorded one run on 7 October: 8.18 km in 45m 47s with activity training load 173 and aerobic effect 4.2.
adherence_caveats: Garmin did not identify the heart-rate sensor source in the available activity summary, so chest-strap use is not assumed.
No perceived effort, pain, terrain, symptoms or intent is inferred.
Warm conditions may contextualise heart rate, but they do not change the adherence verdict.

environment.observed_temperature_range: Garmin device measurement: 19–25°C during the run.
environment.humidity_dew_point_context: A reliable route-time Sydney hourly humidity/dew-point estimate was not available, so none is reported.
environment.heat_impact_interpretation: Coaching inference: the warm end of the device-temperature range could have contributed to elevated heart rate, but the size of any heat effect cannot be quantified from these data.
environment.limitations: Garmin temperature is a device measurement and may differ from shaded ambient air temperature.

recommendation.title: Full rest; skip the Thursday group run
details: Do not run, cycle, perform strength work, or add make-up mileage today.
Skip the usual Thursday group easy run; the social routine does not outweigh 34h 30m of recovery time and a high 1.5 workload ratio.
Optional only: 20–30 minutes of very easy walking or 10–15 minutes of gentle mobility, provided you feel alert and movement is comfortable.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest with normal essential daily movement.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop optional movement for pain that changes gait, dizziness, unusual sleepiness, dehydration symptoms, illness, chest symptoms or any other concerning symptom. Current symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.

signals.label: Low readiness
signals.interpretation: Garmin's combined recovery assessment does not support another training session today.

signals.label: Wednesday training dose
signals.interpretation: Yesterday delivered a substantial aerobic stimulus despite the prescribed rest and should be absorbed before the next run.

signals.label: High recent load
signals.interpretation: The workload ratio has moved above Garmin's optimal range, so adding the group run would compound load rather than restore consistency.

caveats: Sleeping-HR baselines use valid prior nights only because Garmin supplied no valid overnight record for 27 September.
Garmin sleep, heart-rate, HRV, stress, Body Battery, readiness, recovery-time and load values are device measurements; coaching interpretation is stated separately.
The available activity summary did not identify the heart-rate sensor source.
The Thursday group easy run remains Nelson's normal routine, but today's objective recovery and load signals justify skipping it.

run_assessments.assessment: did_not_follow — 8.18 km in 45m 47s (5:36/km), average HR 158, maximum HR 175, training load 173, aerobic effect 4.2 and anaerobic effect 0.0, with 84 m elevation gain. Garmin labelled the training effect TEMPO and recorded a 19–25°C device-temperature range. The 7 October prescription was full rest.
